title: DOW-UAP-D082, Narrative Statement 4, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a memorandum for record containing a first-hand narrative from a federal law enforcement agent regarding UAP sightings in the Western United States in October 2023.

incidents.summary: Witness 4 observed a bright ball of light, followed by multiple orbs and lights exhibiting hatching behavior and formation flight over a 2-3 hour period.
incidents.quote: The hatching occurred multiple times, I lost track after five occurrences.

incidents.summary: Witness observed chemtrails, a string of lights, and light sources moving between mountains and appearing/disappearing at eye level.
incidents.quote: the light darted between the top and bottom of the mountain within seconds

incidents.summary: Witness observed lights moving in patterns and a dark object with a red light hovering between mountain ridges.
incidents.quote: This looked like an actual object and from my vantage point it seemed to be using the terrain to stay hidden.

incidents.summary: Witness observed a yellow light that moved quickly from North to South.
incidents.quote: I saw a yellow light appear at my eyeline; I was about 2k above ground.
